candidates.title: Zelenskyy to visit Britain as Burnham pledges fresh support for Ukraine
candidates.excerpt: The meeting comes at a difficult time for the Ukrainian President, days after the U.S. made a deal with Russia for diesel exports and U.S. President ‌Donald Trump said Mr. Zelenskyy should be replaced as ‌Ukraine’s leader
